FIX the Widget Customizer at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`

READ the file first, then fix these specific space/UI optimization issues. DO NOT change the loader or action.

## Issues to fix:

1. **REMOVE the duplicate "Save changes" button at the bottom** (lines ~962-969 section). The page should have the save button in the page header using `slot="primary-action"` instead of the current inline approach. Change to:
   ```
   <s-button slot="primary-action" variant="primary" onClick={handleSave} loading={isLoading}>
     Save changes
   </s-button>
   ```
   And remove the top section that currently has the description + save button inline.

2. **REMOVE the top description section entirely** (lines ~638-649). The page heading "Widget Customizer" is self-explanatory. No need for a description paragraph.

3. **Text & Messages section (lines ~823-889)**: Currently EACH text field is wrapped in its own `<s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">`. This creates 5 separate bordered cards for 5 text fields — massive space waste. Instead, put ALL 5 fields together in a SINGLE `<s-box>` with a `<s-stack direction="block" gap="base">` containing the fields. Each field is just `<div style={FIELD_STYLE}>` with label + input, no individual box wrapper.

4. **Remove redundant `<s-paragraph>` descriptions** at the top of sections that are self-explanatory:
   - "Display Mode" section: remove "Choose how the size chart widget appears on product pages." (the heading says it)
   - "Colors" section: remove "Customize the widget color scheme to match your brand." 
   - "Typography & Spacing" section: remove "Control the visual rounding of the widget corners."
   - "Text & Messages" section: remove "Customize the copy that appears in the widget."

5. **Trigger Settings section (lines ~691-717)**: Has nested `<s-heading>Trigger Style</s-heading>` and `<s-heading>Popup Position</s-heading>` INSIDE a section that already has `heading="Trigger Settings"`. Remove the inner `<s-heading>` elements and their `<s-paragraph>` descriptions. Just show the components directly. Use `<s-text>Trigger style</s-text>` as a simple label if needed.

6. **Features section**: The checkbox + label area is fine. The Custom CSS box is fine. Keep these as-is.

7. **Aside "Display Mode Guide" section**: Compact — keep as-is.

8. **Aside "Current Settings" section**: Keep as-is — already clean.

## Space optimizations:
- The Display Mode cards use `gap: "12px"` — change to `gap: "10px"`
- The Color picker grid uses `gap: "12px"` — change to `gap: "10px"`
- The Trigger type cards use `gap: "8px"` — fine
- Position grid uses `gap: "8px"` — fine

## After changes, the Widget Customizer should:
- Have ONE save button in the page header (slot="primary-action")
- No description paragraph at the top
- Text fields grouped in a single card instead of 5 separate cards
- No redundant sub-descriptions in section bodies
- No nested headings
- Significantly more compact

## Rules:
- Keep loader and action EXACTLY as they are
- Keep all sub-components (DisplayModeCard, PositionGrid, TriggerTypeSelector, ColorPickerField, TextInput, FieldLabel, WidgetPreview) — just fix usage
- TypeScript strict, zero `any`
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` after changes
